notes: Fresh source pages independently corroborate exact ITEM QUALITY IDs (not measured processing): Draconium Ore R1=189143/R2=188658/R3=190311; Serevite Ore R1=190395/R2=190396/R3=190394; Khaz'gorite Ore R1=190312/R2=190313/R3=190314; Saxifrage R1=191464/R2=191465/R3=191466; Bubble Poppy R1=191467/R2=191468/R3=191469. All labels come from secondary item-market pages that explicitly display 'Quality rank N of 3'; Serevite is independently corroborated by t-mart/wow-auction README with exact rank links. Primary Blizzard/in-game item-quality glyph remains unchecked. No firsthand random-processing numerical study, actual completed casts, output-item totals, output hit counts, zero outcomes, histograms or refund reconciliation. The original Feb 1 Serevite video remains a timecoded lead only; result frames were not readable in indexed page text. Do not turn rank metadata, input counts, video title or price into a measured drop probability. Existing prior studies not recounted.
